entries.defect: Draw-call count of 1.7k-3.6k per frame is CPU-submission bound in WebGL (three.js costs roughly 5-15 us per call, i.e. 10-50 ms of main-thread time on a mid-range CPU); 11-16 M triangles per frame with no vegetation LOD and 3 shadow re-renders, plus logarithmicDepthBuffer writing gl_FragDepth (disables early-Z for every material) make the 60 FPS target unlikely with headroom; sky.updateEnvironment() regenerates a PMREM every 5 s synchronously, causing a periodic hitch.
entries.fix: (1) Vegetation: add a 2-level LOD (full mesh < 800 m, 2-quad crossed billboard impostor 800-9000 m) and shrink tiles from 4000 m to 1000 m so frustum culling works; drop castShadow beyond 600 m for shrubs/palms. (3) Depth: replace logarithmicDepthBuffer with a reversed-Z / float depth (EXT_color_buffer_float depth24+stencil is enough with camera.near 0.5 and far 45 km) so early-Z works again. (4) Sky: keep 24 steps but render the cloud layer at 0.5 scale with a temporal 2x2 reprojection instead of 0.6 static-jitter; move lightMarch to 3 steps. (5) Buildings: merge per-kind tiles into one InstancedMesh per tile with a kind attribute (cuts ~9x calls); cars: one InstancedMesh with body+cabin merged. (6) Post: run the aerial-perspective pass at half resolution and upsample with the depth buffer; disable preserveDrawingBuffer outside bench capture. (7) Env map: spread PMREM regeneration across 6 frames or cross-fade two env maps. None of these lower the approved look at the tested distances.

flightModel.source: src/plane/physics.ts (FlightModel), src/plane/camera.ts (FlightCamera), telemetry from metrics.json (10 views, 3 s of flight each)
believable: Airframe class matches a DHC-2 Beaver: mass 2350 kg, S 23.2 m2, span 14.6 m (AR 9.2), maxThrust 7.4 kN (T/W 0.32) with linear prop falloff to 95 m/s; computed max level speed ~62-65 m/s and 2.6 m/s climb at 55 m/s are realistic.
Longitudinal derivatives: CL0 0.32, CLa 5.4/rad, Cma -1.15/rad, Cmq -16 (stable, well damped); telemetry in all 9 airborne views settles at alpha 0.012-0.055 rad with no stall after 3 s.

Lateral-directional: Clp -0.45, Cnb -0.10, Cnr -0.16, Clb -0.08 (dihedral), adverse yaw +0.012*ail, engine lag tau 0.7 s, first-order gust random walk at 0.35 Hz with altitude-dependent turbulence; stall onset at 15.5 deg with buffet at 17 rad/s and gentle post-stall CL decay (floor 0.55).

Float buoyancy 22 kN/m per point on 4 float points gives a 0.26 m static draft (matches the 1.97 m datum altitude on water in water-landing) with planing relief from 9-24 m/s and water-rudder steering; ground contacts have lateral grip and brakes.

arcade_like.issue: Roll inertia and aileron power: Ixx 3200 kg m2 is about half a Beaver's (~7000); Cl_da 0.14 per full deflection gives a steady roll rate of 0.311*2V/b = ~134 deg/s at 55 m/s (real ~50 deg/s).
Elevator power Cm_de 0.95 per full deflection with Izz(pitch) 5600 gives snappy pitch; combined with the low speed-dependent FOV it feels twitchy.
arcade_like.suggestion: Cm_de 0.6, Izz 8000, add 0.15 s control-surface actuator lag.

arcade_like.issue: Side-force Cy_b -0.9/rad is 2-3x typical; sideslip decays unrealistically fast.
Water damping: 2600 N s/m per point on 4 points against k 88 kN/m and m 2350 kg gives zeta 0.36 (visible bobbing after touchdown).

Hump drag: with 4 wetted points at 0.26 m draft the hydrodynamic drag at 10 m/s is ~8.2 kN (55*v^2 + 900*v)/6 per point vs 6.6 kN available thrust; takeoff only proceeds nose-up with the bows out, which is realistic in spirit but likely too punishing.
arcade_like.suggestion: linear term 900 -> 500, planing onset 6-18 m/s, bow points 0.8x drag.

arcade_like.issue: Hard floor clamp at ground+1.55 m with velocity.y *= -0.1 and 2.5/s velocity bleed masks contact errors as a soft bounce.
arcade_like.suggestion: Keep as a safety net but log when it triggers; it should never fire during normal water contact.

arcade_like.issue: Chase camera: this.tmp aliasing corrupts the look target with the spring acceleration, and the spring (k 26, c 9) trails by 0.35*v (19 m at 55 m/s); plane centroid after 3 s ranged from (0.48, 0.38) to (1.97, 0.74) across chase views instead of (0.50, 0.57). Positional shake of 0.35 m at 12-15 Hz per unit shake is a violent vibration.
arcade_like.suggestion: Dedicated acceleration vector; velocity feed-forward (desired += velocity*c/k); k 60-80, c 2*0.9*sqrt(k); positional shake 0.08 m plus 0.3 deg rotational shake; camera bank 0.18 -> 0.25 for turn feel.

arcade_like.issue: Cockpit eye at (1.15, 0.62, -0.36) is below the glare shield; exterior shells are visible from inside.
arcade_like.suggestion: Eye (1.05, 0.98, -0.36), layer-mask exterior shells in cockpit mode.

arcade_like.issue: Placement path: place() in the captured build did not run step(inputs, 0) so telemetry, rpm and gearDown were stale (0 KIAS, RPM 600, wheels down over water in every still). HEAD adds flight.step(inputs, 0) but the bench never refreshes the HUD during Bench.step().
arcade_like.suggestion: Verify in the next round: place() -> step(0); Bench.step() -> hud.update(); gearDown derived from heightAt at placement.

flightModel.verdict: The aerodynamic core is a credible light-utility floatplane model (derivatives, engine lag, stall, buoyancy and planing all in plausible ranges); the arcade feel comes from halved inertias, 2x aileron power, over-strong side force and under-damped floats, and the chase camera bug/lag ruins the flight presentation in every chase view. Fix the camera first, then retune inertia/control power.
